text:
elaine: Quick update: deployed a small canary that enables multiplexed gRPC streams + delta-frame compression for runtime responses. initial numbers: p50 end-to-end -20%, p95 -17%, network egress -30% on chat-heavy slices.

fermi: awesome. how many hosts / which slices?

elaine: 12 hosts on dedicated-infer-pool-7. slices: chat-medium, assistant-longform, and a subset of high-concurrency webhook traffic.

priya: client compatibility? any breaking changes?

elaine: no breaking changes for our hosted SDKs; server negotiates streaming and falls back to unary. private/self-hosted customers will need runtime >= 3.7.0. feature flag: runtime.rpc.multiplex_v1.

deploy-bot: deploy:rpc-multiplex-canary started by elaine at 2234567896.

fermi: paste perf deltas by model?

elaine: chat-medium p50 -21.0% p95 -17.5% egress -28%. assistant-longform p50 -24.0% p95 -20.3% egress -35%. worker CPU -10% aggregate.

ops-bot: monitor: added alerts for stream-reset-rate > baseline +0.3% and conn-saturation > 70% for canary hosts.

priya: any regressions?

elaine: small backpressure warnings on 2 hosts during burst; increased max_inflight_streams_per_conn from 4->8 and stabilized. no 5xx increase.

elaine: rollout plan: 30% in 20m, 60% in 90m, 100% in 6h if clear. rollback via FF runtime.rpc.multiplex=false. auto-pause triggers: p95 > baseline+6% OR stream-resets > baseline+0.5%.

fermi: i'll add a runtime/transport dashboard panel to compare unary vs multiplex traces and show per-tenant egress savings.

elaine: will write a short runbook for private customers and the SDK delta-frame helper libs. follow-up: collect 24h/72h metrics and post full benchmark. thanks infra/transport teams. :rocket:
